picks.title: Adobe Unveils New Photoshop AI Tools
picks.excerpt: Tech giant's flagship image editor gains a non-destructive Light Adjustment Layer, Firefly Image 5-powered Instruct Edit with Masks, visual Markup prompting, and a beta AI Assisted Editor in latest update.
picks.rationale: The concrete shipping release of the week — non-destructive light layers, masked instruct edits and draw-on-the-image Markup change how concept and matte work gets done tomorrow.

picks.title: The power of on-premises open-weight models for generative media
picks.excerpt: An look at adopting generative AI open-weight models and how they can improve workflow stability, security, cost predictability, and delivery efficiency.
picks.rationale: Freshest item in the pool and the practical counter-argument to API dependence: run open weights in-house for version stability, client-safe security and predictable cost per delivery.

picks.title: What the Hell Is Indie Slop? How the Video Game Insult Found Indie Film
picks.excerpt: The term "indie slop" migrated from video games to film, turning market anxiety, AI fears, and contempt for amateur filmmakers into slang. Commentary.
picks.rationale: Names the vocabulary audiences are now using to dismiss low-budget work — the reputational risk attached to AI-assisted filmmaking, not the tooling.

picks.title: Six thousand people made a three-minute film about a future worth living in
picks.excerpt: Ten of them present live on Sept 25 in downtown LA. The winner leaves with a $2.5M grant to go make it for real.
picks.rationale: A three-minute film as the pitch format itself — 6,000 entries and a $2.5M grant show short-form video moving from portfolio piece to funding instrument.

picks.title: I Can't Believe This AI Video Generator is Free
picks.rationale: A zero-cost generator walked through by a filmmaking channel — the cheapest way to test whether generative video belongs in a current pipeline.
